About

The man
behind the board.

Robert "Double R" Ross is an entertainment attorney and managing partner building at the intersection of music, business, technology and intellectual property.

With roughly three decades in entertainment law, his practice focuses on music law, AI music rights, catalog transactions, mediation and arbitration.

His legal background includes a JD/LLM from Georgetown University Law Center and a BA in Finance from Fisk University. He leads with plain-language deal-making, proactive protection and a long view of the artists and catalogs behind every transaction.

Through R&R Entertainment and the wider District Opposites ecosystem, Robert works across legal counsel, management, rights strategy and the business infrastructure surrounding artists and intellectual property.

Vanity Projects sits inside that ecosystem — a production company co-founded by Robert with a Brazil-based creative partner.

His approach

The Board Is Set.
Know Your Piece.

Robert's operating principle is simple: know the board, know your piece, protect your players. The work starts with understanding who owns what, what is at risk and what needs to be protected before the deal moves forward.

Plain language. Proactive protection. Long-game thinking.
